name: mailsleuth
description: Checks the email open in Gmail for phishing signs, offline: score, reasons and attachment hashes. Nothing is uploaded.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self' https://mail.google.com
